When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. titles.description: Nathan and Clara face strains as her mental health disability complicates their relationship, leading to misunderstandings and outside pressure.

titles.name: Love Trap
titles.description: A married woman feeling trapped in a crumbling relationship meets a charming stranger who forces her to choose between her family and freedom.

titles.name: Tide
titles.description: Even if it means changing his reckless lifestyle, Melvin tries anything to win Zoe's heart, but he quickly finds that she is a tough nut to crack.

titles.name: Ghost Story
titles.description: Somto’s body is found inside his car after a fatal wreck, but is later discovered alive and married with a new life in Lagos. Is it a ghost or a hoax?

titles.name: Surviving You
titles.description: A woman locked in an abusive marriage seeks to protect her child's happiness. Her past love reenters her life, pushing her to decide her fate.

titles.name: Apartment 13
titles.description: Three friends move into Harmony House and discover a corpse. Now suspects themselves, they must find the real killer before someone else dies.

titles.name: All It's Takes
titles.description: Stubbornly ignoring every warning about his toxic girlfriend, a man is plunged into a chaotic, life-altering web of drama and betrayal.

titles.name: Lost
titles.description: After losing their daughter to an accident, a couple struggles with trauma and hope as they prepare for the birth of their next child.

titles.name: Love Official
titles.description: A marketing executive is at her wits’ end when she’s let go by her boss, who doesn’t recognize her hard work until she has moved on.

titles.name: Benignity
titles.description: When Kudzi is served with divorce papers, she resolves to fight it until her last breath, especially for the sake of her own child.

titles.name: Loving Belinda
titles.description: Playboy Chucks never misses a chance with beautiful women, but Belinda is not one to be trifled with, leading to unexpected consequences.

titles.name: What No One Knows
titles.description: Two women commit shocking acts, neither foreseeing the devastating impact it will ultimately have on both of them and their families.

titles.name: Knockout Blessing
titles.description: Knock Out Blessing is an intriguing tale about a girl named Blessing, whose ambition to achieve her dream and escape poverty, take her down a path that leads into the criminal underworld, and finally face to face with the underbelly of the Nigerian political system.

titles.name: Shelter
titles.description: Hannah and Tahir fall in love while homeless on the streets of New York. Shelter explores how they got there, and as we learn about their pasts we realize they need each other to build a future.

titles.name: One Good Turn
titles.description: A man helps a soldier, who saved his life years earlier, by housing him, and getting him a job. But his kindness will not be returned.

titles.name: Kidnapped
titles.description: Following a bungled robbery, three violent men take a young woman, a middle-aged man and a child hostage on a drive outside Rome to help them escape.

titles.name: First Love
titles.description: A 17-year-old orphan living with his parents’ former caregiver begins to develop secret feelings for her but soon learns she’s suffering from disease.

titles.name: Falling for You
titles.description: A serial killer attacks a commercial artist, which leaves her with amnesia. Then he moves into the apartment next door, in order to finish the job.

titles.name: Mara
titles.description: When a criminal psychologist takes on a mysterious case involving a man strangled to death in bed, she discovers an ancient nightmare demon.

titles.name: Flesh and Blood
titles.description: Filmmaker Mark Webber draws on some real-life family drama to tell the story of a young man coming home to Philadelphia after getting out of prison.

titles.name: Mary Mary
titles.description: A young man becomes torn between his calculating, recently widowed stepmother and his girlfriend who’s just come for a visit from America.

titles.name: George!
titles.description: The serene life of a pilot living in the Swiss Alps is turned upside down when his sister marries and bequeaths him with her big slobbery St. Bernard.

titles.name: Till We Meet Again
titles.description: A young couples vacation to Thailand has heavy consequences and intense moments while they struggle to work through their relationship.

titles.name: Complicity
titles.description: As an ambitious presidential hopeful is implicated in the death of his wife, his path to power becomes obstructed by justice.

titles.name: Room 102
titles.description: Richard, caught in a betrayal, is framed for murder to safeguard a politician. An unexpected twist threatens the culprits as the truth looms within.

titles.name: Memories Unforgotten
titles.description: Strong willed, Buchi and Lara reluctantly find themselves falling in love with each other. Can they each overcome their own pride and prejudice?

titles.name: No Way Out
titles.description: When his wife returns home, a fisherman goes off in search of his male lover, which leads him on a dangerous journey into the sex trade in Manila.

titles.name: InSight
titles.description: An ER nurse is electrocuted by a defibrillator paddle while trying to save a stabbed female patient and begins to manifest the victim’s memories.

titles.name: Sugar Babies
titles.description: A group of young women chase fast money and glamorous lives, only to discover that every reckless choice comes with a devastating price.

titles.name: Checkers
titles.description: Unfaithful couples contract HIV, leading to their daughter's tragic death, as they confront the devastating consequences of their actions.

titles.name: Playing Heart
titles.description: A selfish young man juggles his devoted girlfriend and a wealthy older lover, but his brother's unexpected arrival sparks a tangled web of betrayal.

titles.name: Love Thy Neighbor
titles.description: A widowed nurse's quiet life is shaken when her longtime crush moves in next door, awakening deep hope, desire, and a second chance at love.

titles.name: Hearttraction
titles.description: A woman sacrifices everything to care for her ailing boyfriend, only to be heartbroken when he abandons her for another woman.

titles.name: Terms of Engagement
titles.description: A minister’s appointment sparks backlash from powerful interests, and when he refuses to comply, he faces attacks but remains firm in his stance.

titles.name: Caution in the Storm
titles.description: When a terminally ill woman makes an unexpected recovery, her family finds renewed hope, but a dark secret soon threatens their fragile trust.

titles.name: Just Us
titles.description: A possessive husband wants his wife all to himself. When she becomes pregnant, his behavior turns abusive, driving her to desperate measures.

titles.name: Now and Forever
titles.description: From Danielle Steele’s novel, the story of a couple's seemingly perfect marriage reflects the price of infidelity when the husband is accused of rape.
